page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.2xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 8 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The CPU allocation is dedicated, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU testing and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25% tier. Text processing capabilities are also strong, scoring in the top 25% on Geekbench. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core metrics, falls within the average middle 50% range. Similarly, cryptographic operations, database operations, and static web serving throughput align with average tier expectations.

A notable hardware tradeoff is observed in memory bandwidth. While cached small-block read operations and large-block write operations perform at average levels, the uncached large-block read-only memory bandwidth is weak, placing in the bottom 25% tier. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density offer a stable foundation for general-purpose workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or storage-optimized hardware.

Given its balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio, strong single-core execution, and average multi-core capabilities, this instance is suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, text processing, and database operations that do not require high-throughput local storage or massive uncached memory bandwidth.
